purpose: Crown gate rules for preventing local organ maturity from polluting global Imperium truth.
crown_laws: Local organ maturity is not Core v1 readiness.
Local crown confirmation is not Great Nine assembled.
Custodes prosecution must be external to the organ.
Throne crown gate must not be represented as Throne self-validation.
Scores are overlays unless a separate global law permits mutation.
Game projection is display, not truth authority.

gate_requirements.crown_question: Are claims evidence-bound and forbidden claims explicit?
Does advice remain advisory and risk-aware?
Does integration avoid global readiness pollution?
